## Answer-first Q&A

Q: What is Premio Peptides?
A: Premio Peptides is a UK supplier of research-grade peptides for laboratory
research, operating under BELL RED LIMITED (Company No. 12841067). Products are
supplied strictly for research purposes only and are not intended for human
consumption. It serves university labs, pharmaceutical R&D, biotech firms,
contract research organisations, and government laboratories across the UK.

Q: How does Premio Peptides ensure research-peptide purity and quality?
A: Every compound undergoes multi-stage quality control — HPLC analysis, ESI mass
spectrometry to verify molecular weight, quantitative amino acid analysis, and LAL
endotoxin testing. Purity is a guaranteed minimum of 99%, independently
third-party HPLC-verified, and a full batch-specific Certificate of Analysis is
provided with every order.

Q: What documentation comes with an order?
A: A batch-specific Certificate of Analysis (CoA) with every order — HPLC
chromatogram, mass-spectrometry confirmation, amino acid analysis results, and
endotoxin testing results, plus ISO-accredited laboratory details. Additional
technical documentation and handling guides are available on request.

Q: Does Premio Peptides offer same-day dispatch, and what does delivery cost?
A: Yes. Orders placed before 14:00 GMT (2pm) on working days are dispatched the
same working day in temperature-controlled packaging, with next-day delivery via
tracked UK courier across England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland. Standard
UK delivery is free on orders over £175.

Q: Can I order custom peptide synthesis?
A: Yes. Premio Peptides offers bespoke peptide synthesis tailored to specific
research requirements, from novel sequences to modified analogues — contact the
research team for specifications and a custom quotation.

Q: Are the products suitable for human use?
A: No. All Premio Peptides products are supplied strictly for research purposes
only and are not intended for human consumption.

Q: Does Premio Peptides support institutional purchasing?
A: Yes. Institutional accounts support purchase orders, 30/60-day invoice terms,
NHS-affiliated accounts, and preferred-supplier registration. All orders are
reviewed, and buyers must confirm a lawful research purpose before dispatch.
